title: Overcharge Interest on Rental Property Service Contracts Re-Rating Corrections
content:
**Interest rule.** The overcharge interest on a Rental Property Service Contracts re-rating correction follows how long the most recent installment billed at a rate of zero has been due when the correction is posted:

1. After more than 90 days, the overcharge is multiplied by one plus 0.12 times those days divided by 365.
2. After 31 to 90 days, it is multiplied by one plus 0.01 times the whole calendar months since that due date.
3. After 30 days or fewer, no interest is added.

The due date is the billing period start of the latest installment of the term billed at a portfolio discount rate of zero; the days are the calendar days from that due date to the day the correction is posted. The overcharge is the amount of the correction before interest and goodwill; the correction is rounded to the cent once at the end, never the interest.

## Bands

| Days due | Interest |
|---|---|
| 30 or fewer | none |
| 31 to 90 | one plus 0.01 for each whole calendar month since the due date |
| more than 90 | one plus 0.12 times the days divided by 365 |

## Hypothetical overcharge of $10.00, no goodwill

- Due 45 days, 1 whole month: $10.00 times 1.01, **$10.10**.
- Due 100 days: one plus 0.12 times 100 divided by 365 is 1.032877; **$10.33**.
- Due 30 days: **$10.00**.
